facts.fact: MFWA reports that on 26 November 2025 the CID arrested Democracy Hub activist Wendell Nana Yaw Yeboah over claims that three Regional Ministers were complicit in illegal mining.
MFWA reports that on 20 November 2025 blogger Samuel Amadotor was arrested and detained on a complaint by a former NCA board chairman, accused of publication of false news.

MFWA reports that on 8 September 2025 the Ghana Police Service arrested NPP Bono Regional Chairman Kwame Baffoe on charges including publication of false news after he criticised the Inspector General of Police.

MFWA reports that on 12 August 2025 TikTok creators Prince Ofori and Yayra Abiwu were arrested after a live session on 11 August in which remarks suggested the President and a government official should have been among the helicopter crash casualties.

GHA.note: The 2001 repeal of criminal libel is outside three years; the MDHI Bill's promised repeal of the twin laws is a bill, not a repeal.
The document concerns arrests for speech and states nothing on police station records.
